data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 文集装订的最后一道线
data.description: 周末整理古典部文集，爱瑠穿淡紫衬衫和藏蓝背带长裙坐在活动室桌边。一手压住书脊，另一手将松开的装订线轻轻拉直；她停下来检查针脚，紫色双眼因发现不齐的一处而认真睁大。
data.action: 一手压书脊，一手拉直装订线，认真检查错位针脚。
data.promptProse: Eru Chitanda repairs the Classics Club anthology at the activity-room table, one hand holding its spine flat while the other carefully straightens loose binding thread. Her lavender blouse and long navy pinafore stay clear as purple eyes widen over an uneven stitch. The medium portrait includes the working tabletop and club shelves behind. Soft window light brightens the thread and paper edges, with a small hand shadow marking her precise contact.
